summary: community.crypto deprecated the default acme docs fragment (use acme.basic and acme.account), requires ACME backends to implement get_cert_information() from 3.0.0, and deprecated crypto.module_backends.common in favour of argspec.
questions: What replaces the community.crypto.acme docs fragment?
My custom ACME backend lacks get_cert_information, will it break?

answer_card.title: community.crypto deprecations for plugin authors
answer_card.answer_md:
For custom code built on community.crypto (all removals in **3.0.0**):

- Docs fragment `community.crypto.acme` → use both **`community.crypto.acme.basic`** and **`community.crypto.acme.account`**.
- ACME crypto backends must implement **`get_cert_information()`**.
- `crypto.module_backends.common` module util → use the **`argspec`** module util.
